rationale: T060 homepage source work and static checks are present. T066 proves E2E and accessibility, but visual checks still materially mismatch unchanged baselines and the production build exits 1 while scanning standalone output. Turbo also writes out-of-scope logs. Approve one bounded local verification-build boundary while preserving standalone Docker behavior.

worker_package.objective: Add a cross-platform non-standalone local production-build verification boundary that bypasses Turbo's build task, while preserving the existing production-default standalone output and Dockerfile contract. Add only an explicit environment-controlled next.config mode, a root build:verify script, and a small Node/tsx launcher. Do not modify homepage source, Dockerfile, snapshots, reports, content, docs-ingestion, search, governance, operations, or external systems.
verify: Guard exact apps/web/.next target, remove only validated reparse-point children without following links, and remove exact root.
Verify source/configuration/Dockerfile hashes before and after; inspect port 3101 but do not run browser or visual-update commands.
pnpm build:verify; require the launcher to invoke only the web Next.js production build with verification output mode and record actual exit status.
Verify apps/web/.next contains valid production output, no standalone tree or reparse points, and no .turbo, test-results, snapshot, or source writes occurred.
Verify unset/default production configuration still selects output: standalone and infrastructure/docker/Dockerfile is unchanged.
stop_if: Build boundary requires changing Dockerfile, lockfile, dependencies, homepage source, snapshots, reports, content, docs-ingestion, search, governance, operations, or external systems.
Exact .next cleanup target is ambiguous, is a reparse point, or any link cannot be removed without following it.
build:verify invokes Turbo, recreates standalone output, writes .turbo logs, or cannot provide actual successful exit status.
Verification build fails twice for the same in-scope cause.
Default standalone configuration or Docker packaging contract would be weakened or made implicit.
Any visual:update, snapshot change, assertion weakening, or approval of mismatched baselines occurs.

evidence: T060 homepage source/material/footer work passed format, lint, typecheck, and unit tests; E2E/build failed on generated .next reparse-point scanning.
T066 cleanup passed; E2E 4/4 and a11y 4/4 passed; visual diagnostics produced 3/3 mismatches with snapshots unchanged.
T066 production build exited 1 at .next/standalone/apps/web/node_modules/next and touched three Turbo logs outside its allowed roots.
next.config.ts selects standalone in production; turbo.json runs the full build graph and declares .next/dist outputs.
T017 recorded successful standalone Docker build and /health runtime after the existing Dockerfile contract.

parallel_safety.reason: The build boundary, generated .next tree, process environment, and production verification share one runtime surface; run one sole Worker.

missing_evidence: Actual successful local production-build exit after the boundary change.
Post-T060 visual acceptance without approving or changing baselines.
Current-source standalone Docker packaging revalidation after the build boundary is established.
Repository-backed raster-media provenance and truthful font-loading evidence.
Completion evidence for docs-ingestion, search, governance, hardening/operations, and external activation.
